subject.title: fix(memory): exclude extraPaths from shared scope hash to avoid unnecessary reindexing

question: Should same-workspace memory-source agents share one SQLite store by default, and if so what migration and session-visibility contract must that shared store provide before merge?
rationale: This changes shipped persistent memory storage, agent/session visibility semantics, and plugin-visible SDK surface, so automation cannot safely choose the product boundary from code shape alone.

options.title: Redesign shared store before merge
options.body: Require an accepted storage and visibility model, upgrade/rebuild behavior, and focused proof before changing the default database path.

options.title: Accept directory-bound sharing explicitly
options.body: Maintain the workspace-directory boundary as the product rule, but require the PR to document and prove the migration cost and session visibility implications.

options.title: Pause this branch for the canonical issue
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95724 as the design tracker until the storage and privacy model is ready for a new implementation.

recommendation.title: Redesign shared store before merge
recommendation.body: Require an accepted storage and visibility model, upgrade/rebuild behavior, and focused proof before changing the default database path.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current per-agent SQLite storage path and have the clearest recent history around memory migration/reindex behavior.
